# Pixel Lineage Wiki

> The complete Pixel Lineage wiki: evidence-led guides, verified codes, class progression, and database systems. Every claim carries its source.

## Guides & Meta

- [Pixel Lineage Class Tier List](https://pixel-lineage.quest/tier-list/class-tier-list/): Comprehensive ranking of all 6+1 base classes and 21 super classes with damage multipliers and solo viability.
- [Pixel Lineage Tier List Hub](https://pixel-lineage.quest/tier-list/): Overview of class, race, and talent synergies with optimal Torment builds.
- [Pixel Lineage Best Races](https://pixel-lineage.quest/races/best-races/): Racial tier rankings, passive bonuses, and roll probabilities.
- [Pixel Lineage Attributes Guide](https://pixel-lineage.quest/attributes/): Stat scaling formulas, diminishing returns, and respec mechanics.

## Codes & Rewards

- [Pixel Lineage Active Codes](https://pixel-lineage.quest/codes/): All verified active working codes, rewards, and Goblin Merchant redemption guide.
